subject: Request: signed resale certificate + signatory authorization letter for ship-to mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: billing@roselinelogistics.com
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Resale certificate + signatory authorization needed for invoice clearance (RL-4721)

Hi Evan / RoseLine billing team,

Thanks for the recent order — we have an invoice on hold pending resale/exemption evidence. To clear the invoice and apply tax-exempt processing going forward we need two items from you: 

1) A signed resale certificate that includes RoseLine Logistics' legal business name, EIN/Tax ID, and a handwritten or electronic signature with the signer's printed name and title.
2) A signatory authorization letter on company letterhead that states the person who signed the certificate is authorized to sign tax/exemption documents on behalf of the company (or an officer signature). If your process uses delegated signers, a short authorization letter or notarized POA is acceptable.

Please also confirm which ship-to addresses should be covered by the blanket certificate (we need exact ship-to matches to map exemption to outstanding invoices). For reference, the invoices on hold are: INV-2026-3342 (ship-to: 412 Terminal Way, Joliet IL) and INV-2026-3368 (ship-to: 220 Harbor Dr, Long Beach CA).

If easier, DocuSign works fine — we provided a sample template here: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF123456.

Appreciate a signed PDF or scanned copy.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Resale certificate + signatory authorization needed for invoice clearance (RL-4721)

Hi Evan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the partial certificate. A few acceptance criteria from our finance/tax team so we can clear both the current invoices and map a blanket to future shipments: 

- Legal business name on the certificate must match the vendor name on the invoices exactly ("RoseLine Logistics, Inc."). If your invoices use a DBA, please indicate that as well.
- Certificate must include EIN (matches the number you sent) and a dated signature. Electronic signatures are acceptable but please include printed name and title near the signature.
- Signatory authorization: either (a) a brief letter on company letterhead signed by the CFO or GC, explicitly authorizing the Procurement Manager (Sara Lin) to sign resale/exemption certificates on behalf of RoseLine, OR (b) a notarized POA/power-of-attorney that names Sara Lin as an authorized signer. A Legal-signed email alone is not sufficient for blanket coverage.
- Ship-to mapping: please confirm coverage for the two invoices below by providing the exact ship-to line as it appears on the invoice and confirming those addresses are covered under the certificate:
  * INV-2026-3342 — 412 Terminal Way, Joliet, IL 60431
  * INV-2026-3368 — 220 Harbor Dr, Long Beach, CA 90802

If you prefer we can issue a DocuSign packet for the two documents (certificate + authorization letter) with editable fields; send me the email for the person who will sign and I'll trigger it. Karthik, looping you for any legal nuance — is a Legal-signed authorization letter acceptable or do you want notarization requested for CA shipments?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0104

[Attachment: acceptance-criteria-checklist.pdf (pdf)]
